question: A football player is moving southward and suddenly turns eastward with the same speed to avoid an opponent. The force that acts on the player while turning is :
solution:
The force is along the change in momentum, $\Delta\vec{v} = \vec{v}_f - \vec{v}_i$.

$\vec{v}_i = v$ (south) and $\vec{v}_f = v$ (east), so
$$\Delta\vec{v} = v\,\hat{E} - v\,\hat{S} = v\,\hat{E} + v\,\hat{N}$$

Equal east and north components: the force is towards the north-east.
